behaviour-switch.answer: The switch (DialectBehavior.InspectBeforeFromFirstEligiblePosition) decides only where an operand's BEFORE delimiter is looked for when it also has AFTER; at 2002 the BEFORE portion runs from the leftmost position (§2002:14.8.21.3 GR8b) and the operand participates where it meets the AFTER portion (§2002:14.8.21.3 GR8). Probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/op-20261114/read-2002/out-answer/probes-a-05/inspect-ba-f3.cob at --std 2002: TALLYING and REPLACING with the same crossed operand over AYAAXAA gives 05 AYAAXAA (2023: 07 AYAAXZZ): both halves of the format 3 equivalence take the 2002 region.
